quests.question: After the run in July heat, his shirt stuck to his back and his forehead dripped; he was _____.
quests.explanation: A shirt stuck to his back and a dripping forehead after a run show perspiration: sweaty.

quests.question: His plan was 'something big, sometime, somewhere'; nobody could grasp it, so it felt _____.
quests.explanation: 'Something big, sometime, somewhere' is vague and shapeless, which is what nebulous means.

quests.question: Age, taxes and the end of the season; some outcomes are simply _____.
quests.explanation: Age, taxes and the end of the season come whatever we do, so they cannot be avoided: ineluctable, not optional.

quests.question: Nobody had opened the attic in years, and every shelf wore a grey layer; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Years without opening and a grey layer on every shelf mean it was dusty, not spotless.

quests.question: The baby missed his nap, wailed and swatted away every toy; he was _____.
quests.explanation: Missing a nap, wailing and swatting toys away show bad temper, so cranky fits; content contradicts.

quests.question: She twisted her ankle, and by evening it was puffed up and tender; it was _____.
quests.explanation: A twisted ankle that puffs up and feels tender is swollen; shrunken and slim contradict.

quests.question: The paper quoted obscure medieval texts that only a handful of scholars have read; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Quoting obscure medieval texts known to a handful of scholars is specialised: recondite.

quests.question: He glanced at the contract for ten seconds and signed; his reading was only _____.
quests.explanation: Ten seconds on a contract is a quick, shallow look, which is cursory; thorough contradicts.

quests.question: From thirty pages, the manager needed only cost, risk and timing: the _____ points.
quests.explanation: Cost, risk and timing are the most important points, which is what salient means.

quests.question: A quiet room, soft lights and no phones made the weekend feel _____.
quests.explanation: A quiet room, soft lights and no phones all help you relax, so restful fits; hectic contradicts.

quests.question: She looked at her watch and sighed as he walked in late, glancing _____ at the clock.
quests.explanation: Sighing and checking her watch as he arrives late shows she meant to make a point: pointedly.

quests.question: A £10 fine for dropping one wrapper seemed fair; the penalty was _____ to the offence.
quests.explanation: 'Seemed fair' for one wrapper shows the penalty matched the offence: proportionate.

quests.question: The towel hung in the shade for hours but still felt slightly wet; it was _____.
quests.explanation: 'Still slightly wet' after hours in the shade shows mild moisture, so damp fits.

quests.question: We went back for seconds and licked our plates clean; the curry was _____.
quests.explanation: Going back for seconds and licking plates clean show a great meal, so delicious fits.

quests.question: If you fail the medical the job disappears, so your offer is _____ on passing it.
quests.explanation: 'Fail it and the job disappears' shows the offer depends on a condition: contingent.

quests.question: His holiday story was cut off because only comments _____ to the agenda were allowed.
quests.explanation: The holiday story was cut off, so only comments that bear directly on the agenda were allowed: germane means relevant.

quests.question: The study took no company money and compared all brands equally; it was _____.
quests.explanation: No company money and equal treatment of all brands show no favouritism, so unbiased fits.

quests.question: With two minutes left, the captain took the penalty and scored; she acted _____.
quests.explanation: Stepping up and scoring with two minutes left shows firm, quick action: decisively.

quests.question: Clear skies, a calm sea and a favourable forecast made the day look very _____ for setting sail.
quests.explanation: Clear skies, a calm sea and a favourable forecast promise success, so auspicious fits.

quests.question: The whole audience roared with laughter and wiped away tears; the sketch was _____.
quests.explanation: Roaring laughter and tears of laughing show the sketch was very funny: hilarious.

quests.question: Members of the public cannot enrol, so this course is open _____ to staff.
quests.explanation: 'Members of the public cannot enrol' shows only staff are allowed, so exclusively fits.

quests.question: Wool scratched his neck all day and he couldn't stop scratching; the sweater was _____.
quests.explanation: Scratching all day because of wool shows the sweater irritated his skin, so itchy fits.

quests.question: The vault was sealed so completely that no air or sound could pass; it was _____.
quests.explanation: No air or sound could pass, so the vault was airtight, which is what hermetic means.

quests.question: The meal wasn't great or terrible, but it filled us and cost little; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Neither great nor terrible but filling and cheap means just good enough, which is adequate; superb contradicts.

quests.question: He interrupts, corrects and tells you how to do your job; his manner is _____.
quests.explanation: Interrupting, correcting and lecturing show a domineering manner, so overbearing fits.

quests.question: The cafe covers its costs and has a steady stream of customers; the business is _____.
quests.explanation: Covering costs and having steady customers show the business can survive: viable.

quests.question: Despite the fever, her answers were clear and organised; she was fully _____.
quests.explanation: Clear, organised answers despite a fever show a sharp, rational mind, so lucid fits.

quests.question: After the rain, the football pitch was brown slop and my boots sank in; it was _____.
quests.explanation: Brown slop and boots sinking in describe a pitch covered in mud, so muddy fits; firm contradicts.

quests.question: Rather than spending the bonus, he put half into savings and half into insurance, acting _____.
quests.explanation: Saving half and insuring half shows careful planning for the future, so prudently fits.

quests.question: When asked about the mistake, she gave full details at once; she was very _____.
quests.explanation: Giving full details at once shows she was open and willing to share: forthcoming.
